Near-misses: the 2025-09-29 P charge is 12 months and 7 days old (372 days), so under the stated window convention (a record dated on or before 2025-10-06 does not count) it drops out of the twelve-month window, so the steady record is 3 not 4; Mochi's Kitten plan is not the senior plan the recheck cycle needs; the S ship-now units are excluded from scheduled-shipment windows; the 2025-09-29 S charge is outside the twelve-month window. user_scenario: You are Danielle Brooks, a graphic designer in Austin who shares a small bungalow with two cats: Olive, a fourteen-year-old shorthair who has been on thyroid pills for a while and now has early kidney trouble, and Mochi, a fluffy Ragdoll kitten you brought home this spring. Olive's vet, Dr. Raman, has just put her on Hill's k/d kidney diet; the prescription went through on October 1 and you bought one 4-pound bag through the Tailwise pharmacy on October 2 to get her started. You are calling because you want to put Olive's prescription kidney food on Autoship so it keeps coming along with her thyroid pills, which already come on Autoship, and you would like the first shipment to go out on Monday, October 26, 2026, when the starter bag will be close to running out. You start by giving your name and your mobile number, 5125550118. If the agent asks for another detail to confirm it is you, you give the last four digits of your card, 1752; you honestly don't remember the date you opened your account or which ZIP code your card is billed to off the top of your head, and you say so if asked. You have no idea how many bags each shipment should hold or how often it should come - you assume Tailwise works that out from Olive's prescription and your account - so you never suggest a number yourself. When the agent asks who eats the salmon dry food that comes on Autoship, you explain that both cats have been eating it, that Olive is coming off it for the k/d, and that Mochi will stay on it.
